location_exception_reason: Prefabricated metal houses are manufactured commodities with nationwide supply chains; location in title adds no buyer decision value. Origin/GI status is not a product attribute for this MCAT.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'MS Frame House Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged.
